# Published crawler address lists (excerpt)

A few prefixes of each list as its operator published it, read on 2026-11-04, with the list's own `creationTime`.
Tests serve these files from a loopback server in place of the operators' URLs, which `src/owner/bots/operators.ts`
lists. `amazon-searchbot.html` wraps the JSON the way Amazon's page embeds it, and the Cloudflare files are plain
text like `https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4/`.
